Hanoi has two egg coffee legends and people fight over which one is better, so here is the honest comparison.

Cafe Giang, 9/10. The original. Nguyen Van Giang invented egg coffee here in 1946, when milk was scarce and he whisked egg yolk with sugar instead, and his family still serves the same recipe at 39 Nguyen Huu Huan in the Old Quarter. 2026 is the 80th year.

Hot egg coffee is about 35,000 VND, the shop opens 07:00 to 22:00, and it is mostly cash, so carry dong. The cup comes sitting in a small bowl of hot water, that keeps it warm while you drink.

Go mid-morning after 10:00 or in the evening after 19:00, because 10:00 to noon and 17:00 to 19:00 the queue never stops. The alley entrance is easy to miss and the sign is small.

Cafe Dinh, 8/10. The challenger, at 13 Dinh Tien Hoang, up on the second floor of an old building with a balcony over Hoan Kiem Lake. Egg coffee here runs 25,000 to 35,000 VND.

For me, Giang wins on the coffee itself and Dinh wins on the view, and that is the whole argument.

Which one are you picking, the original in the alley or the balcony over the lake? Save this for your first Hanoi morning.

One day in Ninh Binh, three things everyone tells you to do. Here is how I would score them, and I know people will disagree with me, that is the point.

Mua Cave, 9/10. Nearly 500 stone steps up a limestone peak, and from the top the whole Tam Coc valley opens up at once, river, rice fields, karsts, and a stone dragon on the summit.

The ticket is 150,000 VND now, up from 100,000 in April 2026, so any guide still saying 100k is out of date. Open 06:00 to 19:00, the climb takes 20 to 30 minutes, allow 1.5 to 2 hours for the whole visit. Go 07:00 to 09:00 or 16:00 to 18:00, because between 10:00 and 15:00 those steps are in full sun with no shade at all.

Trang An, 8/10. The UNESCO boat ride, 300,000 VND per adult, 2.5 to 3.5 hours through caves and hidden valleys with temple stops, Route 2 is the one most people book. It loses points for eating half your day and for being the priciest ticket of the three.

Tam Coc, 7/10. The classic ride through rice paddies and three caves, 250,000 VND per adult, 1.5 to 2 hours, and the boatwomen row with their feet. It loses points for being the shortest ride and for the crowds between 09:00 and 11:00 and on weekends. Go when the rice is green in May and June, or golden in late September and October.

All three sit within 5 to 7 km of each other, so one day really is enough. Save this for your Ninh Binh day.

What score would you give Mua Cave, and which order would you do them in?

Two weeks in Vietnam, what does it actually cost in 2026? Save this, the numbers surprise everyone.

Backpacker, $1,300 to $1,700 all in from the US or Europe. Mid-range, $2,500 to $3,500. Luxury, $4,500 to $7,000 and up. That covers flights, e-visa, insurance, and everything on the ground.

The budget is decided by 4 big items, and together they eat 40 to 50 percent of a mid-range trip.

One, a Halong Bay cruise, $95 to $450, mid-range $135 to $200.
Two, a Sapa tour, $80 to $550, mid-range $140 to $220.
Three, two domestic flights, $80 to $200.
Four, a tailored suit in Hoi An, $200 to $700, skip it if you do not want one.

The e-visa is $25 single entry or $50 multiple, insurance $40 to $80. Everything else, a bowl of pho, a bed, a Grab, is fixed cheap.

Which of the 4 would you spend the most on, and which would you skip?

An old quarry lake in Tri Ton that locals call a "tuyet tinh coc", the water shifts colour with the light and the season. Best from October to April, and the rice fields around it turn gold from September to November.
Soc Trang's bun nuoc leo is a Kinh-Hoa-Khmer mix built on mam bo hoc, with snakehead fish, shrimp and roast pork. Cay Nhan at 18 Vo Dinh Sam has been at it for over 40 years, 10-33k a bowl.
Tuong Ban from My Hao, Hung Yen, fermented sticky rice and soybean aged in clay jars under the sun. Around 1,000 households make it, over 11 million litres a year, bottles go for 25-40k.

Xoi Yen at 35B Nguyen Huu Huan does sticky rice with shredded chicken, Chinese sausage, a young egg and crispy fried shallots, plus pickled cucumber on the side. 35-72k a portion, open 6am to midnight.
Banh Canh Nguyen Du at 55 Nguyen Du, Quy Nhon, fish-cake noodle soup for 25-40k, open 3pm to 9pm. Order a spring roll on the side, the way the locals do.
